title: GTI Club: Corso Italiano

nvram.name: 941jab_nvram.u39
nvram.sha1_note: MAME also lists nvram.u39 (d0604e84) for this set; 941jab_nvram.u39 is the one it loads last

0x45ecc.note: the idle task's polling loop (0x45e1c-0x45edc, about half the CPU in the attract and in a race): each pass compares 6 state bytes with their previous values and calls the kernel only for those that changed (0x45e48); a pass with nothing changed is skipped (rt_idle)

hot.note: the TEST MODE NETWORK ID item applies a new ID at once through 0x3e4fc(id - 1) (it writes the copy at 0x85906d and sends message 3 to the link task 7, whose handler 0x3e3dc sets the driver's mask, slot and watchdog); called from the net_set_id hook (entry of the per-frame send 0x40a74) in the attract mode. The NVRAM option block has a RAM copy at 0x858740 + offset, checked against the NVRAM checksum in the attract (HARDWARE ERROR on a mismatch), so both change together

ghost.note: a linked race stops with NETWORK ERROR (code 3, check 0x8d968 in mode-4 substates 8-11) when a member of the race mask E (flags bits 14-17) sends no valid in-game packet; nothing drops a member during the race. So a lost node stays a ghost (its last packet, sequence advanced) until the attract mode; in the race (substate 11) after 10 s its flags get 0x80 (race over) | 0x20 (ready at the end), so the others do not wait 2 x 232 frames at the goal; in the setup substates 9-10 its +0x10 bit 31 (solo) makes the others drop it from E (0x89ae4). Mode 7 in the own packet is the error state (fatal 0x3af3c, sticky), NETWORK ERROR on the screen. Flags word at +4: bit 31 active, bits 27-30 mode (4 = game), bits 23-26 substate

network.note: TEST MODE NETWORK OPTIONS, NETWORK ID: bits 6-7, ID - 1, set at every boot to 1 or --net-id. The JAB dump is set to 2 (the race HUD says PLAYER 2). The link: LANC (K056230) at 0xffe98000, runtime/net.c

nvram_options.note: TEST MODE option block: big-endian 16-bit words from start to the checksum word (included) sum to 0xffff

calibration.nvram_note: written after the calibration: PROMOTION MODE on (0x85 bit 7; ver EAA's starting NVRAM already has it, ver JAB's does not). The rest of the byte is 0 in both dumps: Internet ranking off, no bonus credit

notes: Japanese version. The NVRAM declares a cabinet with a handbrake and a K-type force-feedback wheel (MOTOR TYPE: K-TYPE).
The calibration is TD2's script plus the motor-driven steering test (about 50 s, needs RT_FFB_WHEEL, set automatically by the first-run calibration) and the HAND BRAKE step.

setup.note: TEST MODE -> COIN OPTIONS -> FREE PLAY on -> SAVE AND EXIT

widescreen.note: gl state at fixed addresses: projection slots (0x3452 = current) of 6 matrix terms at 0x26dc + 24*slot (row 0 first) and 6 frustum values (left, right, bottom, top, near, far) at 0x270c + 24*slot; viewport x scale 0x2940, x centre 0x2944, y scale 0x2948, y centre 0x294c. The hooks sit right after each write.

font.note: A8 textures of the attract captions: letters (VRAM 0x6e400) and the digits in the same style (VRAM 0x5e400, e.g. the SELECT A CAR countdown)

label: SPEEDOMETER
TACHIMETRO
game_options.note: TEST MODE speedometer: km/h (0) or mph (1), on the race HUD (checked: both games show mph with the bit set); the fonts have no slash

label: ATTRACT SOUND
SUONO IN DEMO
game_options.note: TEST MODE: ALL THE TIME / ONCE EVERY 4 CYCLES / COMPLETE OFF

name_entry.note: ranking name entry: the steering wheel position picks one of these characters, then DEL and END (0x8388c, the index wraps around); a pedal (or the button bit at 0x82c) confirms. The index is in r24 at 0x839b4, r3 at 0x839f8 is the result of the pedal check 0x84350

course_select.note: SELECT A COURSE (0x8cab0, the steering read at 0x8cac8; EAA +0x24): above -0x2000 TOWN (0), down to -0x7000 COAST (1), below MOUNTAIN (2), so the centre and the whole right side are TOWN; a course not yet available falls back (the mask at +0xa4 of TOC 0x124)

transmission_select.note: SELECT TRANSMISSION TYPE (0x8c010, the steering read at 0x8c024; EAA +0x24): at or below -0x2aaa MANUAL (1), otherwise AUTOMATIC (0), the default with the wheel at rest

modes.note: EXTRA modes (runtime/modes.c). state / player: TOC slots (TOC 0x154da8 + 0x54 / + 0x488) holding the own state struct (the link packet, 0x7f5eb8: flags at +4, mode bits 27-30 = 4 in a game, substate bits 23-26 = race_substate from the countdown to the goal, 14 at the TIME OVER) and the player's car object (0x8c1d28: x +0x174, z +0x178, height +0x17c, speed m/s +0xcc, heading +0xc4). time_state: the race clock, a field of the state struct (offset, shift, bits) in 1/57.5 s, set at 0x6ec5c, extended at 0xaa6f4, shown by 0xb461c (0x1172e0 is only the HUD's copy); 0 ends the race. gravity: the per-frame acceleration of an airborne car (pool *(TOC+0x570) + 0xa4, read at 0x700dc into +0x1f4 of the car, applied at 0x70454, 0.0233056) and 9.80665 at 0x102334 (read at 0x9465c, lateral acceleration in g of the car: body lean), each with its value, all scaled by the same factor
modes.note_player_flight: the player car's flight (0x700c0): height player_y, vertical displacement per game frame player_vy; the airborne flag player_air (byte) and its frame counter player_air_frames (16-bit); on its first airborne frame (counter 0) the game sets player_vy from player_vy0. Lifting the car without the flag does nothing (the road takes it back, even 2 m up); with the flag set it flies. player_pitch: the car's pitch (radians, positive nose down) and its smoothed copies: in the air the game adds a constant to +0x1dc every frame up to a limit (0x7048c), so the nose drops; holding them at 0 keeps the car level
modes.note_hud: where the modes write (logical 384-line units): the top lines, clear of the game's HUD, and the announcements
modes.note_cars: the race's cars (TOC+0x590 = 0x8d4608, + 0x18): 6 entries of 0x134 bytes, the player's first, then the CPU cars; position (x, height, z) +8, the frame before +0x14, velocity per game frame +0x38 (the previous one +0x44); a CPU car's position is kept only here (and copied to the render lists), so writing it moves the car. +0xec points to the car's progress (its byte 0 ranks the cars at 0x98430). A CPU car's vertical velocity per game frame is +0x48 (car_vy); in the air it loses cpu_gravity (0.035) every frame
modes.note_marker: the hook car_marker sits at the entry of the routine drawing the marker over a car (0x65bbc, called at 0x64d08): r3 the marker's byte (bits 3-5 the player, 4 = CPU; bits 0-2 the place, 0 = TOP), f1 the distance (out of the range pool+0x200..0x204 it draws nothing); marker_pos: the register of the caller with the car's draw record and the offset of its x (z follows)
modes.note_effect: the fire and smoke a car shows when hit hard: the routine drawing a CPU car (0x64be4, record in r18) reads the record's flag word +0xa8 at 0x65a90 and starts the effect (0x68114(on, slot, record)) while bit 0x2000 is set, stops it when cleared, updates it from the record (0x68cd0: x +0x64, height +0x78, z +0x68, ...). The hook car_effect sits at that read. car_record: the word of a car array entry pointing to its draw record (the player's is 0). effect_slots: the TOC slot of the effect slots (*(TOC+0x4ac) = 0x8c58c8, 0x28 bytes each, byte 0 active, x/height/z at +4); slot 0 is the player's, started by calling effect_start and moved to player_pos (x, height, z in the player's car object) every frame
modes.note_laps: each car's progress record (car array entry word +0xec, progress): place (byte 0, 1 = first), lap (byte 1), sector (byte 2), distance of the laps done (+0xc = lap * lap length, *(TOC+0x400) + 0x2c, TOWN 5321.06), in the lap (+0x10), total (+8, what the places compare); 0x8f74c steps the lap at the line. At every sector 0xaa71c copies the player's lap and sector into the race record *(TOC+0x554) (+0x11, +0x12) and, once the lap is past the race's laps (+0x10; TOWN 1), calls the goal (0xaa8fc: status 2, FINISH!); its callers (0xaa540) check only while the record's lap is not past the laps. race_laps: that TOC slot and the offset of the laps; lap_length: TOC slot and offset of the lap length. Found with RT_WATCH on the state word (the finish sets its flags 0x40, 0x80, 0x20 from 0xb4324, which reads the status 0xb44c8)
